text: I visited an acupuncture clinic because the pain from tennis elbow was so severe that even clenching my fist was difficult. Although there are other long-standing and famous Chinese medicine clinics in Chiang Mai, I felt I would need multiple treatments, so I looked for a place nearby and ended up here. The doctor recommended five sessions, and I completed my fourth today. I had already been stuck in a vicious cycle of treatment and recurrence for tennis elbow in my left arm for nearly three years, and I have experience receiving Pro-Rinse injections twice in Korea and once in Chiang Mai. However, this time, I developed acute tennis elbow in my right arm, causing significant discomfort in my daily life, so I tried acupuncture treatment for the first time. Although it takes longer than Pro-Rinse injections, it is definitely effective, and I really appreciated being able to receive treatment for shoulder stiffness or wrist pain whenever I had them. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone suffering from chronic pain or sudden muscle and ligament pain. The doctor here is a young person who studied in China and is very kind and proactive. For your reference, communication in Chinese is the most fluent here for foreigners, but English is also available.
